description:
SNP haplotypes of a gene across a diversity panel: accessions grouped by their SNP alleles in the gene
+-2 kb (MAF >= 0.02, <= 20% missing), each haplotype with size, number of alternative alleles, whether it is
reference-like and its accessions, plus the SNPs (position, alleles, frequency and, where the panel genome is
annotated, the coding effect: missense, synonymous, stop_gained, stop_lost, start_lost, splice_site, with the
amino-acid change). Each haplotype lists its protein-changing alleles. Panels: 'napus289_A' = A subgenome (A01-A10) SNPs of 289 B. napus accessions plus 199 B. rapa; 'napus289_C' = C subgenome (C01-C09) SNPs of 289 B. napus plus B. oleracea accessions; both on the ZS11 assembly (BRAD napus289 dataset). Sample names are the VCF codes: SamA_ (199, B. rapa in the A file), SamC_ and Bol (B. oleracea and C-genome relatives), Bni (2, B. nigra outgroup), R, Bna and _GSS (B. napus). The VCF is a PLINK export whose REF allele is provisional (often the major allele, about 10% differ from ZS11), so 'reference-like' haplotypes mean major-allele-like here.
gene: an Ensembl B. napus gene (BnaA10g22080D, GSBRNA2T...) or a ZS11 gene ID (BnaA10G0000100ZS); Ensembl genes are matched to ZS11 genes through the DIAMOND best matches of gene_in_assemblies (HZAU pan-genome reference)
